war_summary: War 139 is on day 95 with no winner and conquest not ended. Colonial forces hold a clear strategic-base majority across the map, controlling all bases in many regions (e.g., AcrithiaHex, AllodsBightHex, DeadLandsHex, MooringCountyHex) while Wardens hold smaller pockets (e.g., BasinSionnachHex, ClansheadValleyHex, ReachingTrailHex). The heaviest pressure is concentrated in split or contested regions: CallahansPassageHex (Warden 8/Colonial 2, massive accelerating casualties), ClahstraHex (Warden 5/Colonial 3, 15 recent capture events), EndlessShoreHex (Warden 9/Colonial 1, 14 events), OnyxHex (3/3 split, 17 events), OarbreakerHex (Warden 5/Colonial 4, 39 events), MooringCountyHex (Colonial 10/Warden 2, 19 events), and GodcroftsHex (Colonial 6/Warden 3, 8 events). Several other regions show rising enlistments and casualty acceleration despite no recent ownership flips, suggesting building pressure. Uncertainty remains high because recent event logs are sparse or missing in some high-casualty zones (e.g., CallahansPassageHex, SpeakingWoodsHex, MarbanHollow), and the 24-hour event windows may not fully capture live base transitions.
